supports.question: Does the edited image appear to be a drawing made from chalk?
supports.criteria: Pass if the edited image as a whole has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing. Fail if it clearly does not have that appearance, including when it shows only an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect. Unknown if the edited image is unavailable or the appearance cannot be determined.
supports.binding: O1: Judge the edited image against the requested outcome of a chalk drawing; supporting evidence does not independently earn completion credit.

supports.question: Does comparison with the input image show that the requested chalk-drawing transformation has progressed?
supports.criteria: Pass if comparison shows some change toward rendering the image as a chalk drawing, even if the transformation is incomplete. Fail if there is no requested progress; unrelated edits alone do not count. Unknown if the images or comparison are insufficient to determine progress.
supports.binding: O1 and the rubric: assess progress toward the requested chalk-drawing transformation, not unrelated edits.

parsed.fulfillment_criteria: Apply the original rubric to R1. Return yes only when support 1 passes: the edited image is a chalk-made drawing. Return no only when support 1 fails and support 2 fails, establishing no requested progress. Return partial when support 1 fails and support 2 passes, establishing some but incomplete requested progress. Return unknown when the evidence needed to distinguish these outcomes is unresolved. Support 2 is conditionally skipped when support 1 passes; that skipped observation remains unobserved, and the endpoint evidence alone establishes completion. A skipped support does not count as a failure or as evidence of progress. Unrelated edits never count as requested progress.
